control_name: P&C policy messages validate against the ACORD P&C XML schema
control_objective: Every outbound and inbound P&C policy message exchanged over the integration platform validates cleanly against the published ACORD P&C XML (XSD) schema, so that carrier and agency partners receive structurally conformant transactions.
risk_addressed: Non-conformant P&C messages that violate the ACORD XSD cause downstream parsing failures, rejected submissions, and silent data loss at carrier and agency endpoints, breaking straight-through processing and creating reconciliation and E&O exposure.

required_data_elements.business_definition: The full XML payload of a P&C policy message flowing through the integration bus.
The version of the ACORD P&C XSD against which the message is validated.

method.summary: Validate a sampled population of P&C messages against the registered ACORD P&C XSD and count any validation failures.
steps: Sample P&C policy messages from the integration bus over the assessment period.
Resolve the current ACORD P&C XSD version from the schema registry.
Validate each sampled message against the XSD.
Count messages that fail XSD validation and compute the percentage validated.
method.sampling_rule: Sample all P&C messages where volume permits; otherwise a statistically representative sample across message types.
method.fallback_logic: If the bus or schema registry is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any P&C message that fails ACORD XSD validation is a conformance exception.

pass_criteria: No sampled P&C messages fail ACORD XSD validation.
warning_criteria: Fewer than 100% of sampled messages were schema-validated.
fail_criteria: One or more sampled P&C messages fail ACORD XSD validation.
exception_handling: Quarantine the offending message flow and re-test before resuming straight-through processing.

assertions.description: No P&C messages fail ACORD XSD validation.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each assessment cycle before recertifying carrier integrations.

actions_on_fail: Notify Integration Architect and Chief Architect
